_readme: Google sign-in. Copy this to config/auth.json on the server and fill it in — auth.json holds a client secret and is never committed. Create the credentials at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials: OAuth client ID, type 'Web application'. Paste the redirect URI that login.php shows you into 'Authorised redirect URIs' there, exactly as given.
_redirect_uri: Leave blank and the app works it out from the request. Set it only if the app sits behind a proxy that rewrites the host.
